draft.title: New Queen Oatmeal Quilted Coverlet – 90 x 96 in
draft.description: New Cloud Weave Quilted Coverlet in oatmeal for a queen bed. Measures 90 x 96 in and includes 1 coverlet. Made with a 100% cotton shell and polyester fill. Machine washable. Price: $89 USD.
draft.visual_brief: Use original photographs of the actual oatmeal coverlet rather than the supplied illustration. Lead with a full, well-lit view spread flat or styled on a queen bed so the overall quilted pattern and colour are easy to see. Add a close-up of the quilting and a separate photo of the product label or packaging where the queen size, 90 x 96 in dimensions, material information, care information, and one-coverlet count can be read. Keep the background uncluttered and avoid including unrelated bedding or accessories that could make the one-piece offer unclear.

rationale.claim: Use a product-focused lead photo and a second detail/label view; the inspected comparable shows its packaged bedding and a front product label in one clear frame.
State the size and piece count plainly because comparable titles foreground bed size and set quantity, while this offer is one queen coverlet.
Use exact supplied specifications and price to distinguish this single coverlet from multi-piece comforter sets in the recorded sample.

draft.limitations: Recorded Marketplace evidence is a replayed Dallas-area sample, not live research. No exact queen coverlet listing was found, and only one closely related detailed bedding listing had a cached image available to inspect. The comparable asking prices are not sales prices or demand evidence. The merchant-supplied product visual is explicitly a synthetic illustration rather than a photograph; an actual-product photo, label, and packaging appearance could not be verified.
